svg.title: DDN route geometry comparison
svg.desc: Four diagrams compiled from the same data. Geometry changes do not change objects, relationships, or callout numbers. Source: examples/18-routing-comparison.ddn.
svg.text: One data model. Four connector geometries.
DDN 0.3 • Actual source-to-SVG outputs • Routing is independent of drawing look.
